notes.title: Patch v1.3 (Car Launch Bug Fix, New Songs, Chassis Rake, +more)
notes.content:
FIXES:
- Fixed car launch/kickflip bug
- Added 2 new Dazegxd songs; "way 2 good(idc)" and "won't tell nobody"
- Increased AI speed
- Added red neon
- Increased car paint reflection brightness and improved how it reacts to light
- Added Ride Height and Front/Rear Camber into wheel adjustments
- Added Chassis Rake handling category adjustment
- Fixed 'Wildfire Prototype' having mismatched end plates
- Fixed Switchblade circuit dash gauges not appearing in UI
- Fixed lay-by wall collider
- [ PATREON ] Added "SPEKTER" bodykit

notes.title: Patch v1.0611 (Better Car Paint, More Music FX Settings, Less Pop-in, +more)
notes.content:
FIXES:
- Car paint improvements
- Increased brightness
- Made brightness settings look better and work better
- Fixed handbrake input being activated during phone calls on certain input maps
- Fixed bug where you if ran out of fuel and then ended the night you'd get stuck
- Fixed UVs being wrong on certain rims
- Improved RAM usage a bit
- Added buildings to reflections on "ultra" graphics setting mode and during photomode on other graphics settings
- Increased chunk size for less pop-in
- Increased difficulty slightly
- Added more variants to 'MUSIC FX' settings and made 'full off' louder
- Added steering input deadzone
- Added remove camera tilt option
- Improved accuracy of reset point and direction
- Fixed being able to buy extra parts even if you don't have enough cash

notes.title: Patch v1.023 (Reshade, Remappable Controls, Lowered AI grip/weight, +more)
notes.content:
FIXES:
- New Reshade in driving area and Tatsumi PA
- Added remappable controls
- Fixed fast travel not stopping speed sometimes
- Lowered AI grip/weight
- Increased AI 'player avoid'
- Improved Handling (less understeer at high speed, more oversteer at low speed)
- Removed camera crash effect that would make the camera clip out of bounds
- Improved player livery memory management
- Made loading screens faster
- Buffed Drag Tires launch when they are hot
- Added language/region filter for main menu date, which was causing crashes for certain regions (mostly S.E.A languages)
- Nerfed small wheels speed advantage
- Added fix for tunnel entry launch bug
- Fixed being able to quit a Crew Challenge race
- Fixed bug where player could remove engine part mesh
- Fixed bug where car auction selected car would continue driving
- Removed tape noise from loading screen
- Added tweaks to how car paint looks
- Fixed storage money glitch
- Fixed Camshaft upgrade effects on redline and top speed
- Fixed chassis roll being wrong when reversing
- Fixed ETC toll light not appearing on car
- Increased FOV in cockpit camera when at 0 speed
- Fixed streetlight flares getting 'out of sync' with actual streetlight after freeroaming for a long time
- Changed how headlight flares and streetlight flares look
- Mini-map GPS will show automatically when you have a GPS target
- Added headlight beam fog on med+high light settings
- Added option to turn off speed blur
- Fixed lens flares showing through 3rd brake light and rear view mirror
- Lowered AI difficulty of Tomoika ETC Toll booth
- Fixed some number plate formatting inaccuracies
- Fixed AI spin out on 'Koto City East Loop'
- Reduced wait time at race start for pausing/opening GPS

notes.title: PATCH v0.9995 (GPS Navigation, New Handling, Difficulty Slider, +more)
notes.content:
FIXES:

- New livery Import system that should fix windows 11 crash
- Added cheat to change crew ownership -> pause game when in PA, press 'EnterLocation' button(Y,TRIANGLE, F). Crew will change when you leave the PA.
- Added GPS path that shows in mini-map
- Added race path that shows in mini-map
- Added zoom to mini-map GPS with arrow keys/Dpad up and down
- Added more torque to low powered cars
- Added AI difficulty in SETTINGS -> GAME
- Added option to hide the new blue location icons in SETTINGS -> GAME
- Added Midnight Club inspired drafting visual aid
- Added more FOV to car camera when not moving
- Added fix for game not launching when using certain windows regional formats
- Added option to hide photomode preview UI for steam screenshots
- Added fix for g-company not changing after beating the boss
- Added "Domin8r - GUM.MP3" to the garage music playlist
- Increased torque floor on all cars
- Automatic gearbox will downshift sooner
- Lowered grip and reduced understeer
- Added manual clutch shifting to Stock and Street Transmissions -> Faster shift when use clutch than sequential
- Shortened race win flyby sequence
- Increased walk speed after a period of time, mostly in Tatsumi PA
- Sped up customization fading to/from black during UI
- Fixed AI de-spawning sometimes when far in front of player
- Fixed tire marks sometimes floating
- Fixed some street tires being invisible
- Fixed headlight flares on Sykina AI car
- Changed pause game key to "ESC"
- Added scroll bars to some option menus
- If player finishes race before AI, in final summary AI will get estimated time instead of "DNF"
- If race loss is coming out of betting cash, race final cinematic will show it
- Lowered noise level in driving scene
- Hidden checkpoints in photomode

- Added cheat to manually change crew ownership -> pause game when in PA, press 'EnterLocation' button(Y/TRIANGLE, F). Crew will change when you leave the PA.

notes.title: Mini Patch v0.9981
notes.content:
Small fix patch just for the crew attack bug and some of the new settings not saving correctly. Bigger patch coming in <48hours from writing this.

FIXES:
- Infinite loading screen when arriving at Tatsumi PA for crew attack
- Fixed invert camera and bumper gears settings not saving
- Increased AI difficulty slightly (still lower than launch difficulty)

notes.title: PATCH v0.998 (AI Fix, +more)
notes.content:
FIXES:

- Lowered difficulty for the early game races, will slowly increase as player wins races
- Lowered AI anti-ram speed threshold
- Lowered g-company AI racer's HP targets
- Lowered drag race difficulty
- Lowered fast travel cost and removed possibility of no fast travel offer
- Increased stock car handling
- Increased stock car torque in high gears
- Fixed AI anti-pit prevention not working
- Added AI Racer 'HP estimation' when you look at them in the PA
- Added option to move shifting controls to bumpers (located in SETTINGS -> GAME)
- Added tutorial hint for GPS
- Added tutorial hint for change camera
- Added inverted look options for walk and car cameras (located in SETTINGS -> GAME)
- Added highlighted zones for intractable areas
- Added more brightness to driving map
- Added white cross on GPS for race checkpoints
- Raised TPS cameras height
- Moved GPS into bottom left corner
- Removed 'express delivery' option, you now will just pay for 'delivery' of parts.
- Removed option to enter storage from choosing category
- Can skip race start cutscenes all the time, except boss races
- Loan shark can now call you when you leave PA
- Changed loading screen videos codec back to H264 from VP8

KNOWN BUGS:
- game crashing on livery import for some people
- AI sometimes falling through map/disappearing when too far ahead
